heading_en: Defaulted Exposures to Owner-Occupied Residential Real Estate, etc.
summary_ja: 自己居住用不動産等向けエクスポージャーが延滞した場合のリスク・ウェイトを百パーセントとし、延滞の解消・再発・九十日超基準の規定を準用する。
summary_en: A defaulted owner-occupied residential mortgage takes 100%; the cure, re-default and 90-day rules of Article 38 apply.
paragraphs: Where an exposure falling under exposures to owner-occupied residential real estate, etc. is a defaulted exposure, notwithstanding the provisions of Article 35 and the preceding Article, the risk weight of that exposure shall be 100%.

The provisions of paragraphs (3) through (5) of the preceding Article shall apply mutatis mutandis to the determination of defaulted exposures relating to exposures to owner-occupied residential real estate, etc. In this case, the term "the items of paragraph (1)" in paragraphs (3) and (4) of that Article shall be read as "the items of Article 38, paragraph (1)", the term "paragraph (1)" in paragraph (5) of that Article shall be read as "Article 39, paragraph (1)", and the term "items (iii) and (vi) of that paragraph" shall be read as "Article 38, paragraph (1), items (iii) and (vi)".
